fixtureBounds.source: Synthetic local accounts and a single gated local PATCH; deliberately old/24h-boundary DTO rows test the display cutoff. No real ledger, OAuth, account, provider, payment or remote D1 acceptance.

independentSourceReview.verdict: No unresolved scope or privacy issue in reviewed activity DTO and authorization
independentSourceReview.authorization: ledger_principal expenses:read, selected workspace/role and same-snapshot validation; API-key workspace and target restrictions retained. Key logs expose expense records only.
independentSourceReview.actorPrivacy: Immutable actual actor kind/userId/name/githubLogin only; no private email, access token, API key name/hash or full stored identity.
independentSourceReview.movedTargetPrivacy: Cross-target key reads redact inaccessible opposite target to restricted and conceal opposite snapshot values.
independentSourceReview.timeWindow: Opaque cursor freezes server upper time; lower bound advances with server now minus 86400 seconds. UI separately expires loaded rows without an API timer.
independentSourceReview.atomicity: Business mutation, original financial event, new activity projection and bounded 16-row retention companions share the original CAS transaction. Exact replay and no-op projections do not duplicate activity.
independentSourceReview.snapshotBoundaryReview: The initial 18KB emoji example exceeds the existing 8192-byte Worker raw-body ingress limit and is unreachable by valid HTTP writes. Keep the existing bounded 16KiB activity snapshots; backend regression covers the valid ingress boundary separately. Final backend regression uses note 1600 emoji plus multilingual purpose near 8KiB, then edits with another full Unicode note and preserves exact before/after values; no schema-size increase needed.

persistentLayout.scope: Local GET-only fixtures; browser engines and simulated viewports, not physical devices. No save, CSV download, external delivery or screenshots.
